high.title: Deputy Prime Minister Requests Interest Rate Reductions to Lowest Possible Level
high.summary: At the regular government meeting on May 4, Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Van Thang acknowledged the State Bank of Vietnam's efforts in monetary policy management, particularly directing the banking system to reduce lending rates. However, he demanded more effective and substantial solutions going forward, especially regarding lending rates that directly impact business operations. "We must ensure lending rates are at the lowest possible level," the Deputy PM emphasized, requiring priority credit allocation for production and business sectors. He also highlighted the responsibility of commercial banks to share more burden and called on the SBV to support reducing the spread between deposit and lending rates. This directive signals potential further monetary easing and lower borrowing costs for businesses, which could stimulate economic growth but may pressure bank margins.

high.title: Military Bank (MB) Interest Rates May 2026: What's the Highest Rate After Recent Adjustments?
high.summary: MB Bank maintains its tiered deposit rate structure with two categories: under VND 1 billion and VND 1 billion and above. For deposits under VND 1 billion, rates range from 0.05%/year for demand deposits to 7.2%/year for 24-month terms. The highest rate of 7.2%/year applies to 24-month deposits, followed by 7.0%/year for 36-60 month terms. For larger deposits (VND 1 billion+), rates are slightly higher across most tenors. This rate schedule reflects MB's strategy to attract longer-term deposits while maintaining competitive yields in the current monetary environment.

medium.title: Fifth Largest Bank System Sees Asset Decline as Customers Withdraw Over VND 15 Trillion in Deposits
medium.summary: MB Bank's total assets decreased by over VND 4.5 trillion to VND 1,611 trillion at end-Q1 2026, mainly due to reducing deposits at the State Bank from VND 68.5 trillion to VND 15.2 trillion. This reflects liquidity management adjustments amid changing monetary conditions and deposit outflows.

medium.title: Over 2,700 Employees of Major Vietnamese Bank Resign
medium.summary: Sacombank reduced workforce by 2,736 employees to 14,080 in Q1 2026, the lowest in over 10 years. This coincided with a 43% drop in pre-tax profit to VND 2.1 trillion, reflecting operational challenges and restructuring efforts.

medium.title: Billions of USD Preparing to Land, Vietnam Awaits Important Event in June
medium.summary: FTSE Russell updated Vietnam's eligible stock list to 23 stocks and adjusted Vietnam's weight in global indices. Estimated ETF inflows could reach USD 1.3 billion when changes take effect in September 2026, representing significant foreign capital flows into Vietnamese markets.

medium.title: VN-Index Could Surpass 1,900 Points, Securities Firm Identifies Companies with Growth Potential
medium.summary: MBS believes VN-Index could breach 1,900 points after 5+ weeks of recovery, though markets may enter broad-based correction as capital concentrates in select stocks. Support levels identified at 1,780-1,800 points for any pullback.

medium.title: SSI Research Warns of May Correction, Reveals 9 Stocks Worth Accumulating
medium.summary: Vietnamese stock market posted strong 10.7% recovery in April after 11% decline in March. SSI expects potential correction in May information vacuum despite strong Q1 earnings showing 20% revenue growth and 34% profit growth.

medium.title: Securities Stock Hits Ceiling After Announcing Important Document
medium.summary: HSC shares hit ceiling at VND 28,450, reaching 8-month highs with market cap rising to VND 30.7 trillion. The surge followed announcement of large-scale capital increase plan, reflecting positive sentiment in the securities sector.
